subject.title: fix(config): dedupe warning spam and slow restart storms

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100569 lands or is rejected, should maintainers close this broad branch, or revive and rebase it for the remaining service-policy/docs changes?
rationale: This PR is protected by maintainer signals and now overlaps a focused replacement, while the remaining launchd restart-policy change is an availability tradeoff that automation should not choose.

options.title: Close after replacement lands
options.body: Let the focused warning-dedupe PR own the remaining bugfix and close this broad branch once that path is resolved.

options.title: Revive as service-policy PR
options.body: Rebase this branch, drop duplicated warning-dedupe work, and make the launchd/docs changes explicit with macOS service proof.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave both PRs open temporarily if maintainers want to compare the broad and focused approaches before deciding.

recommendation.title: Close after replacement lands
recommendation.body: Let the focused warning-dedupe PR own the remaining bugfix and close this broad branch once that path is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the focused replacement and stated the intent to close this broad branch after that replacement lands.
